name: robots/fdcl-gwu__uav_simulator
title: FDCL-GWU UAV Gazebo simulator
intro: FDCL-GWU UAV Gazebo simulator, adapted from fdcl-gwu/uav_simulator. It reads `mode`, `motors_on`, `read_state` and `read_imu`; runs `set_flight_mode` and `motors_off`. `set_flight_mode`: publish one ModeData flight-mode request on /uav/mode; the receipt confirms transmission only, not mode execution, and the publication does not turn the motors on. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
